$comment: Clone groups of scripts/audit/clones_struct.mjs kept on purpose. A group is silenced when EVERY copy's file matches one of `files` (and, with `name`, one copy is that function). Triaged 2026-10-24 (docs/code-audit.md).

entries.reason: both draw through components/FormQrCode/QrPanel; what is left is each wrapper building its own URL (the API host form page vs the SPA ballot route, deliberately not one "id + kind" component, see SessionQrCode's header) and its own words and tones (the ballot one also prints the URL)

get_agent / get_project / get_product_context: the tool-definition skeleton every server tool has (toolSpec, serverTool, parseToolInput, resolveId are already shared); the description, pack, route, answer shape and side effect (projectAccess.record) differ per tool

the prioritization list's empty card (centred, icon tile, h2) and the public ballot's recorded notice (role=status, ok-toned banner, icon beside the text): different layout, role and tone; only the 'icon + title + text' shape matches

the S3 empty-folder note (centred, bare icon, two lines) and the jobs section header (row with an icon tile and an h2): different layout and heading semantics; only the 'icon + two lines' shape matches

two three-way enum -> icon switches (trend up/down/flat at 14 px, a checklist step done/pending/todo at 20 px with a spinner, shared by the onboarding buddy and the role playbook since 7.66.00): different icons, sizes and classes; a shared helper would be a lookup table as long as each switch

two one-button components of different areas: a labelled primary 'Add a passkey' (login namespace) and the icon-only Delete document with its title and screen-reader name (the one delete button of the document page and the prototype pane); only the 'busy -> spinner, else icon' shape matches, and a shared busy-button would take the class, the icon, the label and its placement as parameters

each document kind's DocumentAdapter (the surface's one interface: id, content type, policy, permissions, versionOf, load) over its own API, version key and read-only rule; the shape is the interface's
each step kind's inspector switching over its own tabs (agents vs checks, reviewers and packs) to its own views; only the exhaustive-switch shape and the shared Arrows and Assertions tabs match

two features' icon buttons (a file's Reprocess, a token's Remove), each its own label, icon and tones: the shared part is the design system's labelled icon button recipe (a Tooltip kind=label around the button)

the two knowledge reviews read their overview the same way through the shared pieces (knowledgeReads.useKnowledgeRead, components/LoadFailed/ReadPending); what matches is those calls and the empty line, each over its own read, words and view

two loading placeholders, each drawn in its own card's shape (the forms list card's three zones, its title, figures and controls; the project card's icon, title, line and button): what matches is the design system's `skeleton` recipe in a three-item map, and one component would take each card's layout as props

a list of rows with one control each: Prioritization's archived metrics (inside a details, Restore per metric) and 7.64.00's saved focus groups (a link per document and its date); only the 'map rows to an li with a button' shape matches
